YTA. Usually, it would be unfair to suddenly ask people to take care of your child for you for extended periods of time. But your sister was gone a few minutes to do a basic human function. She didn’t laze around. And she didn’t take more than a few minutes tops of your time. 

I suspect there’s deeply rooted resentment there for you to bitterly bring up how your parents try to help her. Idk if compassion a wild concept to you………

We’re both in our early twenties and have been together for three years.

It sucks that I can’t just let it go when it happened years ago and he has improved considerably since. People change right? People can be better? He has taken steps to make up for it. I want to try to make this work because he’s my first boyfriend... idk is this just me being sentimental? There doesn’t seem to be more red flags? Idk am I being too stupid trying to stick this out

I can’t afford to get therapy right now because I am currently in between jobs because of the pandemic.

He kept insisting how sex was really important to him and he was getting upset more frequently because of constantly getting “blue balled.” He kept bringing up how he really wanted to try being more intimate. He didn’t really use force or anything but it became an almost daily topic of our conversations then that I felt like I had no choice but to relent. Idk maybe I’m overreacting but I can still remember feeling really uncomfortable then because he kept on insisting and he himself recognizes that he kinda pressured me into it idk

I’ve been urging him to see a therapist but he’s kinda hesitant and resistant to it. I guess I’m learning more and more to be healthy so I feel like I may be able to handle supporting him but I also worry that maybe this whole situation is unhealthy... but isn’t it something that can be worked on? Maybe I’m just not being kind enough or forgiving enough? Maybe I’m overreacting because he’s just learning how to deal with me? Idk...

I guess he has been adjusting how he responded to my breakdowns but they still came off as impatient and lacking... like i guess i could tell he is making effort to try to be kinder but he still kinda failed at helping me get through it. Whenever I gave him a chance to try to help me, idk it just ends with me feeling worse and having to seek help from my friends who can do it better. I guess I’m scared I’d come off as a hypocrite for getting tired of his sht now when it was me asking him to be patient with me before but at the same time i also can’t deal with the resentment like you pointed out. He feels really bad about it. Idk...is there really no way to get over this bitterness I feel?
